statement.p: If the gradient of f is \nabla f = 2z\,\mathit{\vec i}+x\,\mathit{\vec j}-4yx\,\mathit{\vec k} and the point P = (-4, -10, 8) lies on the level surface f(x, y, z)=0, find an equation for the tangent plane to the surface at the point P.

static.solution: P=(-4,-10,8) we have \mbox{grad}\, f = 16\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j}-160\,\mathit{\vec k}. Hence the tangent plane to the level surface f(x, y, z)=0 at the point P is given by the equation 16\mathopen{}\left(x+4\right)-4\mathopen{}\left(y+10\right)-160\mathopen{}\left(z-8\right) = 0, or z = \frac{16\mathopen{}\left(x+4\right)-4\mathopen{}\left(y+10\right)}{160}+8.
